prompt_text: Best donor CRM with all features in one plan
response_text:
Based on your query (“Best donor CRM with all features in one plan”), you’re essentially looking for:

- Donor-centric CRM (not generic sales CRM)  
- “All-in-one” (fundraising, email/engagement, events, maybe memberships/volunteers, reporting)  
- Minimal add‑on upsells — as much as possible included in a single plan  

From the sources you shared and what’s known in the nonprofit CRM space, here’s how the top “all-in-one” options stack up, and which are most likely to give you the most in one plan.

---

## 1. Sumac CRM – Most functionality in one ecosystem

From source [1]:

> “Sumac CRM is easily one of the best all-in-one CRMs for 2026… offers the most functionality, allowing you to manage everything in one place:  
> – Donations & fundraising  
> – Case management  
> – Memberships  
> – Volunteers  
> – Grant management  
> – Prospecting  
> – Custom add-ons”

**Why it fits your ask:**

- Very broad feature set in a single platform (especially rare case management + fundraising combination).  
- Designed to minimize juggling multiple tools.  
- Known for relatively affordable, transparent pricing vs many “enterprise” nonprofit CRMs.

**Trade‑offs:**

- Interface and usability can feel less slick than “modern” tools like Givebutter or Neon.  
- You may still need add‑ons for very advanced marketing automation or complex events, depending on your use case.

**Best for:**  
Organizations that need *a lot* under one roof (e.g., human services, case management, grants, volunteers, plus donors) and want to avoid a stack of separate tools.

---

## 2. Givebutter – Modern all‑in‑one fundraising + CRM

From source [4]:

> “Givebutter is a modern nonprofit CRM that combines donor management, engagement tracking, and personalized communication tools with a full suite of fundraising features—all in one platform.”

**What you get in one system:**

- Donor CRM (contacts, giving history, segmentation)  
- Fundraising tools: campaigns, events, peer-to-peer, donation forms, text-to-give  
- Email, SMS, stewardship tools  
- Basic marketing automation, supporter journeys  
- Easy online payments and modern UX

**Why it’s strong for “all features in one plan”:**

- Givebutter’s model is “free” platform + payment processing, so you’re not constantly stepping up into more expensive tiers to unlock core features.  
- Many nonprofits run their *entire* fundraising & donor communications program inside Givebutter without extra tools.

**Trade‑offs:**

- It’s excellent for fundraising/engagement; less focused on things like detailed grant management, membership org complexity, or case management.  
- Some advanced analytics or highly customized workflows might still require external tools or exports.

**Best for:**  
Small–mid sized nonprofits (and even many larger ones) that want *fundraising + CRM + communications* in one visually modern platform with minimal nickel‑and‑diming.

---

## 3. Bloomerang – Donor-first CRM with unified giving

From source [3]:

> “Bloomerang is a unified giving platform built specifically for nonprofits, combining donor management, online fundraising, engagement tools, and reporting…”  
> With features like:  
> – Constituent timelines  
> – Fundraising tools  
> – Engagement and generosity scores  
> – Data segmentation  
> – Custom reports

**Why it’s compelling:**

- Very strong donor‑centric database and reporting.  
- Built‑in online giving pages, email, and engagement scoring.  
- Designed only for nonprofits, so workflows and terminology match fundraising reality.

**Trade‑offs for “all in one plan”:**

- Pricing tiers: advanced features (marketing automation, some integrations, etc.) may require higher plans.  
- Less “all you can eat in one flat plan” than Sumac or Givebutter; more of a laddered model.

**Best for:**  
Organizations that care deeply about donor retention, segmentation, and analytics, and are okay that “everything in one plan” may still mean a higher pricing tier.

---

## 4. Neon One / NeonCRM – All-in-one membership + fundraising

From [1] and [6]:

> “NeonCRM is a nonprofit software… to assist in donor engagement, fundraising and membership programs in a single platform.”

**You typically get:**

- Donor/constituent management  
- Online forms & fundraising  
- Membership management  
- Events & registrations  
- Email marketing and some automation  
- Integrations with accounting and marketing tools

**Trade‑offs:**

- Functionality is broad, but some modules or advanced capabilities may be priced as add‑ons or higher tiers.  
- Implementation/configuration can be more involved.

**Best for:**  
Membership-heavy organizations and mid‑sized nonprofits that need solid CRM + membership/events in one system and are okay navigating tiered pricing.

---

## 5. Little Green Light – Affordable and surprisingly complete

From [5]:

> “If you’re looking for a powerful CRM that won’t break the bank, Little Green Light is a fantastic option… packed with all the essential features you need, including fundraising and appeal management, constituent records, and reporting.”

**Why it’s relevant:**

- Flat-ish per‑record pricing rather than tons of feature‑based add‑ons.  
- Strong for: constituent records, gifts, pledges, appeals, events, tasks, reporting.  
- Integrates easily with many online giving tools.

**Trade‑offs:**

- More “core donor database + fundraising” than full marketing automation or advanced engagement tools.  
- Often used with separate email & forms, so not *truly* everything in one product.

**Best for:**  
Small–mid organizations prioritizing value and stability over having every possible module under one vendor.

---

## Other options from your results

- **Kindsight (formerly Ascend, etc.)** from [2]: focuses on health systems and HIPAA compliance, “grateful patient” programs—great if you’re in healthcare, probably overkill otherwise.  
- **Generic “best fundraising” lists or YouTube overviews** ([7]): helpful for quick comparisons, but they usually showcase a mix of point solutions and CRMs, not necessarily “all features in one plan.”

---

## Direct answer: “Best donor CRM with all features in one plan”

Because “best” depends on your context, I’ll give you *two* top picks depending on whether you’re more complex or more fundraising-centric:

**If you want the broadest functional coverage in one ecosystem:**  
- **Top pick: Sumac CRM**  
  - Most modules under one roof (donations, grants, volunteers, memberships, case management).  
  - Strong choice if you’re trying to avoid multiple systems and need more than just fundraising.

**If you want modern fundraising + communications all baked in, with minimal tier games:**  
- **Top pick: Givebutter**  
  - One of the cleanest “all-in-one fundraising + donor CRM + communications” setups, especially for small–mid orgs.  
  - Many features available without climbing a ladder of paid feature tiers.

**Strong alternatives depending on priorities:**

- **Bloomerang** if donor retention, segmentation, and analytics are your top priority and you’re okay with tiered pricing for higher-end features.  
- **Neon One/NeonCRM** if you’re membership- or event-heavy and want those functions in the same platform as your donor CRM.  
- **Little Green Light** if your top priority is affordability and a solid donor database, and you’re okay adding separate tools for email/forms.

---

If you share your:

- Budget range (per year)  
- Number of contacts/donors  
- Must-have features (e.g., memberships, volunteers, grants, events, texting, automation)  

I can narrow this down to 1–2 recommendations tailored specifically to your situation, and suggest which single plan/edition would most likely cover everything you need.
